seo.description: Visit the Villa des Arts in Casablanca: contemporary Moroccan and international art inside a restored Art Deco villa.
seo.og_description: A beautiful Art Deco villa turned contemporary art museum.

name: Villa des Arts
hero_subtitle: A beautiful Art Deco villa turned contemporary art museum showcasing Moroccan and international modern works.

overview.title: Art Deco Shell, Contemporary Heart
overview.p1: The Villa des Arts occupies a restored Art Deco residence and presents rotating exhibitions of Moroccan and international contemporary art. It is one of the more pleasant cultural stops in the city for visitors who want something beyond monuments and markets.
overview.p2: The building itself is part of the attraction: clean lines, period details and a scale that feels intimate rather than institutional. Check current exhibitions before you go, as the programme changes regularly.
overview.p3: It pairs well with a walk through the surrounding neighbourhood or a visit to other downtown landmarks such as Place Mohammed V. Allow about an hour, more if a particular show draws you in.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Villa des Arts

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Taxi or tram toward the centre / Oasis area. Check the exact address for your map app.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Weekday mornings are often quieter. Confirm opening hours and current shows.

3.title: Tickets
3.desc: Entry is ticketed; prices and hours can change — verify on the day or on the official site.

q1.question: Is Villa des Arts free?
q1.answer: No. It is a ticketed museum. Check current prices locally.

q2.question: How long should I spend?
q2.answer: About one to one and a half hours depending on the exhibitions.

q3.question: What kind of art is shown?
q3.answer: Rotating contemporary Moroccan and international works inside an Art Deco villa.

q4.question: Can I take photos?
q4.answer: Rules vary by exhibition; ask staff if unsure.

q5.question: What should I combine it with?
q5.answer: Place Mohammed V, Marché Central, or a broader downtown walk.
